listing.name: Fleet Tester
listing.summary: Adds a runtime-editable mission for quickly testing battle scenarios, fleet balance, and new tactics.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a runtime-editable mission for quickly testing battle scenarios, fleet balance, and new tactics.

description:
This is a simple utility tool that offers a mission editable on run-time to setup and test various battle scenarios very quickly and test fleet-wide balance or new tactics. It can also help a lot with debugging.

Inside the mission folder you will find two fleet files that will define which ship variants are added to each opposing sides.

Those files can be edited

without restarting the game

, greatly speeding up the testing process.

They can also be used to setup playable challenges, or situation showcasing balance and AI issues.

Happy testing!

aiDescription: Adds a runtime-editable mission that lets you quickly set up and test various battle scenarios, including fleet balance and new tactics. The opposing fleet configurations can be edited without restarting the game, speeding up the testing process. These files can also be used to create playable challenges or demonstrate balance and AI issues.
